title: Bound one tensor axis by two section errors at ceiling 9 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Under the hypotheses `||B_i|| ≤ 9 p^2`, `||C_i|| ≤ 9 p^2 + ε` and `||B_i - C_i|| < 2 ε`, with `ε = p^6 exp(-p^2)` and `||X ⊗ Y|| = ||X|| ||Y||`,

```text
⊗_i B_i - ⊗_i C_i = sum_k T_k,
||T_k|| < 2 (9 p^2 + ε)^{g-1} ε,
||⊗_i B_i - ⊗_i C_i|| < 2 g (9 p^2 + ε)^{g-1} ε.
```

The factor 2 is two section errors on the active axis. HALO's `2g` rectangles stay a volume partition. The scalar shadow uses caps `9`, `10` and `2`; the displayed factors are `8, 7, 6` and `7, 9, 5`. A difference of size `3` exceeds the cap `2` when `g = 1`.

The three norm hypotheses are not proved. The comparison with `2^{-C p}` is #4506 and is not re-proved. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

This answers the open question of #4506. It does not replay #4506. #4488 is the same telescope at ceiling `10 p^2`. Splitting one axis through the section polynomial is left open.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gaussian-tensor-nine-axis`
- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_TENSOR_NINE_AXIS` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `bbde3b0bedb8f7ce17159dfbe913b7e3e5194bab`, priority revision 7. Upstream had moved from `2a13eb18`; κ stayed `23/10000`. The pre-submit fetch `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc` left the HALO blob `5f601b3c8ac368aa79aa1007effe5933a360237b` and the selected-result blob `ed33caef5c5827693e9572d252a66f99cbb73d40` unchanged, so this package keeps the `bbde3b0` baseline.
